Yleisin ja kallein virhe: The most common and costly defect
Ohuet kohdat, puuttuvat naukset ja huono: Thin spots, missing tapes and poorly treated corners. Water always finds the weakest point, often only years later.
Jos lattian kaltevuus ei johda vettä kai: If the floor slope does not direct water to the drain, water pools on tiles and finds its way into structures. Slopes are measured before tiling, not afterwards.
Kierot saumat, ont laattojen alla oleva: Uneven joints, voids beneath tiles and missing movement joints. Visible immediately or, at worst, only when tiles come loose.
Löysät liitännät seinän sisällä vuotavat: Loose connections inside walls quietly leak into structures. Each connection is pressure tested before walls are closed.
Kaivon ja putkien tiivisteet ovat vedene: Drain and pipe seals are the most sensitive waterproofing points. An incorrectly installed seal leaks directly into the floor structure.
